title: Alternative Rock
tagline: Tension, hooks and a little friction in the signal.
summary: Alternative rock gathers the strands of guitar music that refused to fit inside a single pop or underground lane. It grew from post-punk, punk, and college-radio scenes and turned experimentation into a mainstream possibility. Its appeal lies in contrast: sharp hooks, restless rhythms, and the feeling that a song might bend before it resolves.
origin_place: United States and the United Kingdom

pillars.name: Pixies
pillars.why: Pixies made abrupt dynamics and big hooks feel essential, helping define the sound of a new alternative wave.

pillars.name: R.E.M.
pillars.why: R.E.M. showed how strong songwriting and atmosphere could carry a rock band beyond the underground.

pillars.name: Radiohead
pillars.why: Radiohead expanded alternative rock with layered writing and a willingness to shift again and again.
